 SYRACUSE, N.Y. — After a rainy Saturday and a nicer Sunday, we're going back to the rainy weather again for Monday. Here's the hourly forecast so you can plan your day around the weather.
 HOURLY FORECAST 
 Fast-forwarding to the upcoming weekend our computer models are still in disagreement about what will be happening with a developing coastal system. Here's what we do know right now.
 TRACKING POTENTIAL COASTAL SYSTEM NEXT WEEKEND 
 Back to the current weather setup for now through Monday and Monday night is this area of low pressure with a few troughs(extensions of rising motion) pinwheeling around the low.
 LATEST SURFACE MAP 
 As the next trough slides through CNY into sunrise Monday it will have general rain associated with it that will be enhanced by the instability and moisture from Lake Ontario allowing the rain to persist a bit longer.
Let's track when it's supposed to rain and when it's supposed to get sunnier, drier and milder outside:
 FUTURECAST 630 AM MONDAY 
 FUTURECAST 10 AM MONDAY 
 Monday's weather will be very similar to what we experienced on Saturday.
 FUTURECAST 230 PM MONDAY 
 Tuesday will actually be similar to the weather we just had on Sunday.
 FUTURECAST 630 AM TUESDAY 
 FUTURECAST 2 PM TUESDAY 
 Looking at the middle part of the week here will be a small ridge of high pressure allowing for drier, sunnier and semi-milder conditions.
 EXTENDED OUTLOOK 
 As mentioned above the end of this week is still unclear due to models having different solutions on the development and track of a coastal low pressure. 
Some models show sunny and dry conditions, while others have mid and upper 30s, cold rain, very wet snow flying and strong gusty winds. 
Please check back for updates day-to-day and you can always scroll through our text forecast here.
Have a good start to the new week!
